name: Ore wa Aku no Sentouin ~Onna Shuryou no Tesaki ni Natte Seigi no Heroine o Yaru!
original_name: 俺は悪の戦闘員～女首領の手先になって正義のヒロインをヤる！
source:
I was just a company man drinking at the bar after work when a beautiful older woman chatted me up.
Next thing I knew, I was the newest recruit in an evil alliance who gets sent on (naughty) missions! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE134805.html]DLsite English[/url]]
